handles.title: Profile handles
handles.description: Public Instagram handles (with or without @). Each returns ranked posts, formats and best posting times.

postUrls.title: Post / reel URLs
postUrls.description: instagram.com/p/, /reel/ or /tv/ links. Each returns image/video links.

resultsPerProfile.title: Posts per profile
resultsPerProfile.description: How many recent posts to read per handle (4-30).

upstreamTimeoutSecs.title: Scraper timeout (seconds)
upstreamTimeoutSecs.description: Per attempt. A timed-out attempt is retried once with 1.5x this.

upstreamMemoryMbytes.title: Scraper memory (MB)
upstreamMemoryMbytes.description: Memory for the underlying Instagram scraper run. More memory finishes faster.

retryOnTimeout.title: Retry on timeout
retryOnTimeout.description: If the underlying scraper times out, retry once with 1.5x the time. Turn off when the caller has its own time budget.
